name: Topographic Flow
description: Smoothly evolving topographic contours and elevation gradients with continuous or broken survey lines.

controls.name: preset
controls.label: Preset
controls.description: Starting palette and contour configuration. Explicit properties override it.

controls.name: scale
controls.label: Terrain scale (px)
controls.description: Larger values create broader hills and valleys. Independent of contour density.

controls.name: density
controls.label: Contour density
controls.description: More elevation levels reveal closely spaced, nested curves.

controls.name: distortion
controls.label: Terrain distortion
controls.description: Terrain irregularity and the strength of its smooth elevation morph.

controls.name: seed
controls.label: Terrain seed
controls.description: Reproducible terrain composition. Changing the seed creates a new map.

controls.name: lineStyle
controls.label: Line style
controls.description: Continuous, all dashed, or a mixture with every fourth elevation level dashed.

controls.name: lineWidth
controls.label: Line width (px)
controls.description: Uniform stroke thickness in CSS pixels for all elevation levels.

controls.name: opacity
controls.label: Line opacity
controls.description: Opacity of the contours over the background.

controls.name: dashLength
controls.label: Dash length (px)
controls.description: Length of each visible dash along a connected contour.

controls.name: dashGap
controls.label: Dash gap (px)
controls.description: Empty space between dashes, measured along the curve.

controls.name: backgroundColor
controls.label: Background color
controls.description: Terrain background. Omitted Paper colors follow the site or system theme: white in light mode, black in dark mode.

controls.name: lineColor
controls.label: Contour color
controls.description: Color of the regular elevation lines. Omitted Paper colors are black in light mode and white in dark mode.

controls.name: accentColor
controls.label: Major contour color
controls.description: Color of every fourth elevation level; Survey uses these for broken lines. Omitted Paper colors are black in light mode and white in dark mode.

controls.name: gradientDiffusion
controls.label: Gradient diffusion
controls.description: Spread the blend between neighboring elevation colors. Higher values soften color bands while keeping the terrain and contours crisp. Relief uses 0.5; Aurora and Ember use 0.35; Ocean uses 0.

controls.name: grain
controls.label: Gradient grain
controls.description: Fine white photographic grain with soft footprints. Cached at device resolution and fixed in screen coordinates; also textures the contour ink. Gradient presets use 0.55.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Flow speed
controls.description: Rate of the elevation morph. Zero holds the current relief.

controls.name: hoverEffect
controls.label: Effect
controls.description: How the pointer reshapes the contours: rings raises a hill with new contours (default), spread pushes them aside, swirl twists them, ripple sends waves out and drag carries them along the pointer's motion. Presets choose one.

controls.name: hover
controls.label: Strength
controls.description: How strongly the pointer reshapes the contours with the chosen effect. Negative values reverse it; zero disables the mouse effect.

controls.name: hoverRadius
controls.label: Radius (px)
controls.description: Radius of the push around the pointer, in CSS pixels.

controls.name: hoverFollow
controls.label: Follow (s)
controls.description: Time for the effect to catch up with the pointer, and to build when it enters. Higher values trail behind it.

controls.name: hoverFade
controls.label: Fade (s)
controls.description: Time for the contours to return to normal after the pointer leaves. Entering follows the Follow time.

controls.name: paused
controls.label: Paused
controls.description: Hold the current relief without resetting its animation clock.
